I7.1.name: Technology Availability Score

models_ai.assessment: Production-ready LLMs (GPT-4, Claude, Gemini), voice APIs, multilingual support proven at scale

data.assessment: Customer-owned product data, CRM integration, public data sources readily available

hardware_compute.assessment: Cloud infrastructure widely available at reasonable costs ($700-$900/month MVP)

infrastructure_apis.assessment: All APIs production-ready with strong SLAs (CRM, LLM, voice), multiple vendors

build_path.assessment: Established frameworks (LangChain), proven patterns, available talent

I7.1.interpretation: Technology is readily available across all dimensions. Minimal technology risk.

I7.2.name: Competitive Precedent Level

precedents.technology: Real-time AI SDR with conversational personalization, multi-agent architecture
Production voice AI with 620ms latency, 99.99% uptime
Voice AI agent infrastructure with sub-600ms latency
AI BDR with multi-LLM architecture, sales automation
precedents.scale: Y Combinator-backed, handles 80% of BDR workload

I7.2.interpretation: Strong precedent with 5+ competitors building similar technology at scale

I7.3.name: Build Time (MVP)
I7.3.interpretation: Reasonable MVP timeline for seed-stage startup, allows for iteration and Series A prep

I7.4.name: Development Cost (MVP)
I7.4.interpretation: Affordable for seed-stage, represents 65% of typical $2M seed round

I7.5.name: Technical Risk Level

critical_risks.name: Real-Time Latency Degradation
critical_risks.mitigation: Load testing, response streaming, caching, CDN optimization

critical_risks.name: LLM API Cost Overruns
critical_risks.mitigation: Usage monitoring, prompt optimization, rate limits, open-source alternatives

I7.5.interpretation: Moderate risk from third-party API dependencies and unvalidated performance assumptions, manageable with de-risking

overall_assessment.decision_logic: 4 out of 5 KPIs PASS (I7.1, I7.2, I7.3, I7.4), but I7.5 = 3 (Moderate Risk) triggers UNCERTAIN outcome per Recipe 7.1 edge case handling. Third-party API dependencies and unvalidated performance assumptions require de-risking activities before full MVP commitment.
key_concerns: Third-party API dependencies (LLM, CRM) introduce reliability and cost risks
Performance assumptions (<2s latency, 100+ concurrent sessions) are unvalidated
Requires 6-week, $75K de-risking phase before full MVP commitment
overall_assessment.recommendation: Conduct 6-week technical validation phase ($75K) to validate latency and cost assumptions before committing full $1.3M MVP budget. If validation succeeds, proceed with 8.5-month MVP build with high confidence.

activities.name: Latency Validation & Load Testing
activities.deliverable: Load testing report with p50/p95/p99 latency at 100 concurrent sessions
activities.decision_criteria: If p95 >4 seconds after optimization, revise product approach

activities.name: LLM Cost Modeling
activities.deliverable: Cost model with confidence intervals and mitigation strategies
activities.decision_criteria: If costs >$0.10/demo with no mitigation, adjust pricing or switch to open-source

de_risking_plan.timing: Conduct in parallel with fundraising or immediately after seed round close
